coverage_note: The four-template taxonomy (DODB, IODB, DOIB, IOIB) and the opening DODB illustration were readable. The DODB counting formula itself was past the cut.
concepts: Classify every distribution question on two axes: objects distinguishable or identical, boxes distinguishable or identical.
In DODB, exchanging the same object-sets between two different boxes gives a different distribution.
Template names are abbreviations of those two adjectives.
